title: geocardia cordata
intro: Geocardia cordata, commonly known as Heartleaf, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and have antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Geocardia cordata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include vasodilation, which helps to improve blood flow and reduce the risk of heart disease, and its antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress.
